notes.title: Glitch World is out!
notes.content:
Now available

Glitch World is now available on Steam. Will you be one of the first to try it out? 
We are looking forward to your feedback in the comments, reviews, and Steam discussion forum. 

All the best from your friends at Radar! <3 

If you can play it, play it!

notes.title: Coming December 4th!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Glitch World is releasing on December 4th at the following times:


 12:00 PM PST
 8:00 PM GMT
 9:00 PM CET


Make sure you wishlist Glitch World now to be notified of the release and get a chance to profit from the release discount. 

Let us know in the comments if you have any questions.

We are excited! 
-Radar
